about: kvstore's application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: kv-session-skips-the-edge
mutants.rule: A session marks one pacing edge for each request it answers (memory test SessionPacesEachRequest).

mutants.name: kv-session-paces-each-answer-line
mutants.rule: An edge ends a request, not an answer line: a request of several lines or none is one edge (memory test SessionPacesEachRequest).

mutants.name: kvstore-concurrent-lost-update
mutants.from: t.entries.Update() func(entries Map[string, string]) Map[string, string] { entries.Put(key, value) }
mutants.rule: Table.Put updates entries atomically so concurrent puts to disjoint keys never lose an update (memory test TableConcurrentLinearizable under --explore pct).
